benchmark.what_the_source_page_shows: Gold spot price panel: 'USD /oz 3,996.31' with a 'Last Updated' caption, on a page dated '22 October, 2026', with the chart footer 'Data as of 22 October, 2026' and 'Market Data: Provided by ICE Data Services'.
notes: Pass 18 (2026-10-23, 20:23Z): the live World Gold Council panel was re-read in a browser-rendered fetch and displayed USD 3,996.31/oz. This reading replaces the 10:02Z reading of USD 4,024.45/oz as the benchmark, so every derived gold value on the site is recomputed at USD 128.48435/g. The earlier reading is preserved verbatim in prior_captures.

Difference from the previous benchmark (USD 4,024.45/oz): -0.70%. Unlike the Pass 12 change (which came from the data date advancing by one day), this change is an intraday market move: the panel's own 'Data as of' line still reads 22 October, 2026 at both readings.

Independently corroborated within four minutes by three other official market pages read by the same GitHub runner at 20:19Z: Kitco USD 3,996.30/oz (24K row), BullionVault USD 3,996.62/oz, JM Bullion gold ASK USD 4,010.61/oz (an ask, so it includes a premium). These are recorded in cross_check_quotes_2026_10_23 and are informational only; the single calculation basis remains the World Gold Council panel.
Spot is a live market quote; the figure recorded here is a dated reading, not a claim about today's price. Re-read the source before relying on it.

The World Gold Council page states that the LBMA Gold Price is the key benchmark used throughout the gold market and that historical LBMA auction data was removed from the WGC site at the request of ICE Benchmark Administration (licensing).

Independently corroborated by another session: arena/0029d936-gold4 read the same panel at ~20:19Z during its own Pass 17 and reported the same USD 3,996.31/oz before seeing this reading. Two read paths, one number.

secondary_reference.name: LBMA Gold Price benchmark description
secondary_reference.what_the_source_page_shows: The LBMA Gold Price is set twice daily in auctions administered by ICE Benchmark Administration Limited (IBA), commencing at 10:30 and 15:00 London time. Tabulated historical prices have moved to a licensed portal.
notes: No LBMA numerical price was captured from this page (tables are behind an IBA licence), so no LBMA number is quoted anywhere in this project.

constants.troy_ounce_grams_note: Defined exact conversion (troy ounce = 480 grains = 31.1034768 g). This is a definition, not a sourced market claim. Note (2026-10-23): NIST SP 811 Appendix B.8 prints 3.110 348 E+01 g for the troy ounce in non-bold type, i.e. rounded and not exact; the 31.1034768 g figure is exact only as the 480-grain definition.
constants.spot_usd_per_gram_note: value_usd_per_oz / 31.1034768 = 3996.31 / 31.1034768 = 128.48435 USD/g (recomputed by scripts/compute.py and re-checked by scripts/audit.py).

prior_captures.note: Earlier capture of the same World Gold Council spot panel on the same day. Superseded during Pass 2 because the live panel had moved by the time it was re-read. Kept for audit, not used in any calculation.

pass19_live_crosscheck_2026_10_23.decision: Benchmark RETAINED at the stored value. The reading is recorded here as a dated cross-check. No derived gold value was recomputed and no stored value was replaced.
